title: Arrangement points of CLO3D's library avatars, by piece
description: Piece name of the 3D shell -> arrangement point, or {"name": point, "x", "y", "offset", "orientation"}. {side} is replaced by the wearer's side (L or R). A piece is looked up by its full name, then by its first word. Collars are held off the neck (offset in mm) because a collar placed on the point started inside the neck; glove pieces are drafted fingers up, hence orientation 0.

provenance.source: Point names read with get_arrangement_list on a CLO3D 2025.2 library avatar (female, 110 points)
provenance.rights: Names of CLO3D's own arrangement points, listed for interoperability
provenance.notes: Seen live: Body_Front_Center_2 and _3, Body_Back_Center_2 and _3, Body_Front_2_L, Arm_Outside_1_L and _R, Leg_Skirt_Front and _Back, Neck_Collar, Wrist_Back_R. The other names follow the same pattern and are not confirmed: read your avatar's list with get_scene_summary and correct this file.
